user.title: Set up Heating Analysis
user.description: Map the required sources. The analysis only reads; it never controls anything. Power, heat and outdoor temperature must use a matching unit.

data_description.power_entity: Metered mains power of the heat pump, preferably 1KOMMA5GRAD or a local meter.
data_description.heat_entity: Generated heating energy without domestic hot water, if available.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Outdoor temperature at the system location.
data_description.compressor_entity: Sensor or binary sensor that reports compressor operation.

reconfigure.title: Change required sources
reconfigure.description: Required sources only. Optional sources, heating circuits and rooms are in the options dialog.

error.wrong_unit: The unit does not match this source.
error.wrong_domain: The entity type does not match this source.

abort.already_configured: Heating Analysis is already set up.

init.title: Configure Heating Analysis
init.description: Change sources, heating circuits, rooms or thresholds.

sources.title: Optional sources
sources.description: All optional. Empty fields stay unused; the affected metrics become 'unknown'.

data.compressor_runtime_extra_entity: Compressor runtime, second counter (e.g. hot water)

data_description.compressor_runtime_extra_entity: Added to the first runtime when the system counts heating and hot water separately.
data_description.hp_flow_entity: Heat pump outlet (not the buffer). Together with the return this gives the spread.
data_description.volume_flow_entity: Together with the spread this gives the heat output in kW.
data_description.power_now_entity: Current power draw; with the heat output this gives the COP now.
data_description.dhw_power_entity: For the COP including hot water and for cross-checking a total meter as fallback source.
data_description.return_entity: Heat pump inlet. Together with the heat pump flow this gives the spread.
data_description.dhw_operation_entity: Active while the heat pump charges domestic hot water. Used to exclude DHW charging from buffer overshoot.
data_description.dhw_temp_entity: For charges per day, charging time and tank cooling.
data_description.dhw_circulation_entity: When the circulation runs. Shown in the flow diagram and operation, and splits tank losses with and without circulation.

data_description.type: Buffer, radiators, underfloor heating or hot water. The assignment comes from the user, never from entity names.
data_description.target_entity: Optional. With actual and target the analysis shows whether the mixer keeps the circuit on target.

data_description.climate_entity: Optional. Best is the room's Raumklima climate: it provides the real room sensor, the effective target and the valve opening. Without a thermostat the room is listed without control.
data_description.valve_position_entity: Optional. Livisi thermostats do not report a valve position.

thresholds.title: Finding thresholds
thresholds.description: Starting values are placeholders. A rule only applies when measurements exist.

data_description.type: Buffer, radiators, underfloor heating or hot water. The assignment comes from the user, never from entity names.
data_description.target_entity: Optional. With actual and target the analysis shows whether the mixer keeps the circuit on target.

data_description.climate_entity: Optional. Best is the room's Raumklima climate: it provides the real room sensor, the effective target and the valve opening. Without a thermostat the room is listed without control.
data_description.valve_position_entity: Optional. Livisi thermostats do not report a valve position.

plant.title: Heat pump and storage
plant.description: Pick the model from the manufacturer catalogue. The analysis then compares against the datasheet: COP at the same weather and flow temperature, minimum output (cycling), the controller's heating curve and storage losses. Leave empty if the device is not listed. For the frost preview: heat demand of the coming days against the heat pump's output.

error.wrong_unit: The unit does not match this source.
error.wrong_domain: The entity type does not match this source.
error.unknown_circuit: The heating circuit does not exist.
error.circuit_in_use: The heating circuit is still assigned to rooms. Remove those rooms first.

update_inventory.name: Update inventory
update_inventory.description: Set master data of a pump, thermostat or the hydraulics; every change is logged.

object.name: Object
object.description: Section and key, e.g. pumps.hk2, thermostats.bad or hydraulics.

values.name: Values
values.description: Fields and new values. Allowed fields depend on the section.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional reason or remark for the change.

log_change.name: Log change
log_change.description: Record a free-form change without setting master data.

compare_periods.name: Compare periods
compare_periods.description: Compare metrics before and after a reference date.

days.name: Window size
days.description: Days before and after the reference date.

change_time.name: Reference date
change_time.description: Defaults to the newest change log entry.

export_report.name: Export report
export_report.description: Metrics, inventory and change log as Markdown or JSON.

refresh.name: Recalculate now
refresh.description: Re-evaluates the existing data. The integration only reads; it never switches a device.

export_plant_sheet.name: Export plant sheet
export_plant_sheet.description: Markdown plant sheet with layout and settings.
